faq: How soon is my site ready?
A new site is usually ready a few minutes after you pay. We email you when it is. If it's been more than an hour, email support@anypress.io and we'll look right away.
Can I change my plan or size later?
Yes. Email support@anypress.io with your site name and what you'd like, and we'll switch it for you. The new price starts from your next renewal.
Can I use my own domain?

Yes. Every site starts on a free address ending in anypress.site. When you're ready, your account page shows the records to add where your domain is managed, and the secure connection is set up for you.
What happens if I send more emails than my size allows?
Order, account and booking emails always send. Past your monthly allowance, newsletters and email sequences pause until next month, or you can add an email pack to keep them going.

How do I cancel or get a refund?

Cancel from your account: your site stays online until the end of the period you've paid for. Your first payment for a new plan is covered by our 30-day money-back guarantee; email support@anypress.io to ask for it.
